hypothesis: The uniform present-only expert lost slightly overall but improved the highest fit-defined text_load quintile. Route only present rows above the fit-only text_load 80th percentile to that expert while retaining the original C2_B for other present rows and the original C1_B for missing rows.
adaptive_selection_note: This limited route was selected after reviewing the first three candidate results and their subgroup outcomes. It is a follow-up on previously viewed development folds, not a pre-registered independent test.

candidate.threshold_definition: For each fold, q80 = the ordinary linear interpolation 80th percentile of text_load over all rows with cycle_code <= fit_end; route high volume only when text_load > q80. Values equal to q80 stay on the original C2_B expert. Missing-stream routing takes precedence.

comparators: C4_HGB original availability routing (C2_B all rows present; C1_B all rows missing)
present_specialist uniform route (C2_B present-only for all present; C1_B all rows missing)
decision_owner: MAIN selects at most two external Classification candidates under the global milestone guard; this experiment makes no upload decision.
